# OpenTabletDriver

> > A free, open-source cross-platform tablet driver for Windows, Linux, and macOS supporting hundreds of tablet models with advanced input filtering and plugin extensibility.

OpenTabletDriver is a community-driven alternative to proprietary tablet drivers, offering broad hardware compatibility across Wacom, Gaomon, Huion, XP-Pen, and other manufacturers. The project emphasizes accessibility, performance, and user control through a modular plugin architecture and comprehensive documentation.

## Key Topics

- OpenTabletDriver
- Cross-platform support
- Windows/Linux/macOS
- Tablet detection
- WinUSB driver
- HID/uinput
- Permissions
- Plugin system
- Configuration
- Troubleshooting
- Wacom/Gaomon/Huion/XP-Pen
- systemd
- Pressure sensitivity
- Area mapping

## Getting Started

- [OpenTabletDriver](https://opentabletdriver.net): OpenTabletDriver homepage with cross-platform tablet driver for Windows, Linux, MacOS
- [Windows Installation Guide](https://opentabletdriver.net/Wiki/Install/Windows): Windows setup guide covering .NET 8, WinUSB driver, and Zadig installation
- [Linux Installation Guide](https://opentabletdriver.net/Wiki/Install/Linux): Linux setup guide for Ubuntu, Debian, Fedora, openSUSE, and Arch Linux distributions
- [macOS (Intel) Installation Guide](https://opentabletdriver.net/Wiki/Install/MacOS): macOS Intel installation guide with GitHub downloads and Applications folder setup

## Troubleshooting & Support

- [General FAQ](https://opentabletdriver.net/Wiki/FAQ/General): General FAQs covering tablet support, detection, configuration, pressure, and area mapping
- [Windows FAQ](https://opentabletdriver.net/Wiki/FAQ/Windows): Windows troubleshooting FAQs for tablet detection, pressure support, and WinUSB setup
- [Linux FAQ](https://opentabletdriver.net/Wiki/FAQ/Linux): Linux troubleshooting covering systemd, HID, uinput, permissions, and multi-monitor setup
- [MacOS FAQ](https://opentabletdriver.net/Wiki/FAQ/MacOS): macOS troubleshooting for Apple verification, permissions, and installation issues
- [Windows App-specific FAQ](https://opentabletdriver.net/Wiki/FAQ/WindowsAppSpecific): Windows app-specific troubleshooting for osu!, Valorant, Clip Studio Paint compatibility
- [Linux App-specific FAQ](https://opentabletdriver.net/Wiki/FAQ/LinuxAppSpecific): Linux app-specific troubleshooting for osu!, GIMP, Wine, Wayland, and XWayland issues
- [Model-specific FAQ](https://opentabletdriver.net/Wiki/FAQ/ModelSpecific): Model-specific FAQs for Wacom CTL-x100 tablet modes and Android compatibility

## Hardware & Compatibility

- [Tablets](https://opentabletdriver.net/Tablets): Supported tablets database listing compatibility for Wacom, Gaomon, Acepen, Adesso, Genius
- [Tablet configuration reference](https://opentabletdriver.net/Wiki/Development/Configurations): Technical reference for tablet configuration, digitizer specs, and pen input hardware
- [Guide: Adding support for a new tablet](https://opentabletdriver.net/Wiki/Documentation/ConfigurationGuide): Developer guide for adding new tablet hardware support across Windows, Linux, macOS

## Plugins & Extensions

- [Plugins](https://opentabletdriver.net/Plugins): Plugin repository featuring cursor smoothing, calibration, and input filtering extensions

## Documentation & Reference

- [Required Permissions](https://opentabletdriver.net/Wiki/Documentation/RequiredPermissions): Cross-platform permissions setup for Windows WinUSB, Linux udev, and macOS installation
- [Command Line Arguments](https://opentabletdriver.net/Wiki/Documentation/CommandLine): CLI reference documentation for daemon, UI, and console command-line arguments
- [Logs](https://opentabletdriver.net/Wiki/Documentation/Logs): Logging and debugging documentation for GUI, daemon, and systemd log diagnostics
